reason: I'd ask for the free 12.5 cl sample, sure, but I won't put a naturally fermented syrup on my menu until I know it tastes the same every batch. In high season I can't rebuild a signature cocktail because the new bottle came out sourer or fizzier.
objection: It's fermented with no additives, so how do I know the next litre will taste like this one, and that it won't keep fermenting in my fridge? At 23 euros a litre it's also two or three times my usual syrups.
would_change_my_mind: Three samples from three different batches that taste the same, plus a stated shelf life once opened, so I can trust it in a cocktail I sell every night.
